source.field: localRandomValue: 512 bits from NIST's hardware entropy sources, conditioned by SHA-512

source.verification: SHA-512(localRandomValue[i+1]) equals precommitmentValue[i] for every consecutive pair

note: the last pulse is kept only to verify the previous pulse's precommitment
